messages.author: 427356d65a15c6cc
messages.subject: guide_axis
parts:
Dear all,

If I remember correctly, Kohske has posted a nice interface before like 

x <- seq(0, 10, 0.1)
y <- sin(x * pi)

qplot(x, y, geom = "line") +
  scale_x_continuous(guide = guide_axis(position = "top")) +
  scale_y_continuous(guide = guide_axis(position = "right"))


but it looks like ggplot2 0.9.1 has not export guide_axis, I can see that it's still in the package though, my question is that, is there any easy way to put y axis to the right like the code showed above? 


Thanks a lot


Tengfei


--

messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: geom_text position parameter ("dodge")
parts:
Hi all,

Shouldn't the following labels be positioned in similar fashion as the bars? Instead, they all share the same x position. I'm sure this has been addressed but thought someone might know immediately how best to deal with this. Thanks very much.


# test data
tst <- structure(list(g1 = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L), g2 = structure(c(1L,
2L, 3L, 1L, 2L, 3L), .Label = c("a", "b", "c"), class = "factor"),
   m = c(2L, 3L, 4L, 1L, 2L, 3L)), .Names = c("g1", "g2", "m"
), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA, -6L))


ggplot(tst,aes(as.factor(g1),m,colour=g2))+

geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=g2),position="dodge")+

geom_text(aes(label=m),position="dodge",colour="black")



Adam Loveland

messages.author: ddc91303cb21ac62
messages.subject: Re: geom_text position parameter ("dodge")
parts:
Hi Adam,

For what it is worth I would have used facets to construct the plot like so:

ggplot(tst,aes(as.factor(g2),m,colour=g2))+

geom_text(aes(label=m),position="dodge",colour="black") +
  facet_wrap(~g1)

That takes care of the numbering issue as well. Is that what you were looking for?

HTH,

Sam

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: geom_text position parameter ("dodge")
parts:
try this:

pd <- position_dodge(width=1)
ggplot(tst,aes(as.factor(g1),m)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=g2),position=pd) +
geom_text(aes(label=m, group = g2),position=pd,colour="black")
